task.title: Participant form
task.description: A form with method="get": two fieldsets with legend; the card number is required, exactly 7 digits (pattern); a textarea with initial text; a select with two optgroups and selected; every field has label for = id; buttons button type="submit" and type="reset".
task.starter_code: Participant form
hints: The initial text of a textarea goes between the tags: <textarea>Text</textarea>.
List: <select> with <optgroup label="..."> and one <option selected>.

questions.question: Where is the initial text of a textarea written?
questions.explanation: textarea is a paired tag; the text goes between the tags.

questions.question: What does a type="reset" button do?
questions.explanation: reset restores the values set in the HTML.

questions.question: How does a <button> without type behave inside a form?
options: Like submit - it submits the form
questions.explanation: That is why a button always gets a type.

questions.question: What does pattern="[0-9]{7}" mean?
questions.explanation: [0-9] is a digit, {7} is exactly 7 times.

questions.question: What is true about fieldset and legend?
options: A screen reader reads the legend before the group's fields
questions.explanation: Every field still needs a label inside a fieldset.

questions.question: Which attributes check input in the browser?
questions.explanation: placeholder is only an example hint.

questions.question: What is true about <option value="almalyk">Almalyk</option>?
options: almalyk is sent to the server
questions.explanation: The text is shown, the value is sent.
